notes:
Replication title verified against supplied reference. Author-hosted accepted preprint acquired from https://mgto.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/Ziano-et-al-2021-JOEP-Disjunction-effect-replication-extension-preprint-final.pdf . Supplied replication p.7 locator differs from preprint pagination: Table 1 begins on p.7, while replication omnibus row is p.9 and narrative test p.17. Selected between-subject omnibus test matching original design and description; within-subject extension and pairwise tests not merged. Replication paper also reconstructs original statistics, but these were not substituted for unavailable original primary text. Replication narrative rounds Fail percentage to 15% whereas Table 1 prints 16%; this does not alter the selected printed omnibus values.
Source follow-up: Original-only fresh blind validation. Title/authors/year verified on rendered PDF p. 1; target PDF pp. 1–2 inspected visually against the supplied canonical text. Known locator mismatch: PDF p. 2/printed p. 306 Table 1 concerns second-gamble decisions, not the described vacation study; target_match is false for that supplied table/test locator. The vacation study is reported descriptively and supplies condition denominators but no printed Cramer's V, inferential test or p value. An additional N = 123 group on printed p. 306 received both Pass and Fail versions and is a separate follow-up, not included in the three condition denominators. No statistics were computed from percentages. Canonical quote fragments preserve text glyphs; explicit ellipses omit interleaved layout/text. Rendered p. 305 confirms the canonical text's condition sample numbers; no numeric OCR discrepancy observed in the extracted n. Source is the supplied scanned published article, not a manuscript/proof; supplied provenance retains publisher/Crossref range 305–310 versus research-report scan 305–309 and scanned-copy notice on PDF p. 6. No independent resolution of that pagination discrepancy attempted. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
